hero.subtitle: MARGI reads the crowd hour by hour and points you to the calm place with the same feel. Real forecasts, real roads, no guessing.
hero.art: Illustration: a traveller at a fork in the road. On the left a crowded temple road, on the right quiet rice terraces. A small green mascot on the backpack points to the right.

flow.title: How MARGI works
flow.intro: No sign-up to start. Open the app and go.

where.title: Say where you are
where.body: Use your location or pick a town. MARGI never stores where you stand.

mood.title: Pick a mood
mood.body: Temples, beaches, rice fields, waterfalls. Or skip it and see everything.

calm.title: See what is calm
calm.body: The map shows how busy each place will be when you arrive, hour by hour.

go.title: Plan and go
go.body: Add stops, get the road time and the best hour to leave, then open navigation. Sign in only to save.

wait.title: Less waiting
wait.body: Know the quiet hour before you leave, not after you queue.

twin.title: Same feel, fewer people
twin.body: A calmer twin for the places everyone picks.

traffic.title: No jam surprises
traffic.body: Road time with live traffic for every stop.

local.title: Local money stays local
local.body: Family warung and cafés appear on your route.

trust.title: Numbers you can check
trust.body: Every figure comes from data, never from a guess.

change.title: Plan once, change freely
change.body: Swap a stop and the whole trip recalculates.

showcase.title: Four ways into a calmer Bali
showcase.intro: Start from the map, scroll for ideas, ask a question, or go straight to a plan. They all share the same forecast.
showcase.phone: Screenshot of the {{name}} screen in the MARGI app

explore.name: Explore
explore.title: A map that shows the crowd, not just the pins
explore.body: Pick a mood and MARGI scans around you. Every place carries how busy it will be when you arrive, so the calm ones stand out at a glance.

feed.name: Feed
feed.title: Scroll through Bali before you decide
feed.body: Every destination, one swipe at a time. Each card shows the quietest hour, and a calmer twin when the place is packed.

chat.name: Chat MARGI
chat.title: Ask the way you would ask a local
chat.body: A quiet beach near Canggu? Is Tegallalang busy at four? Answers come with place cards you can add to a plan.

plan.name: Plan
plan.title: A trip that dodges the jam
plan.body: Road time with traffic, the crowd at every stop, and the best hour to leave. Change a stop and the whole trip recalculates.

numbers.title: Bali's crowd is not spread evenly.

visitors.label: foreign arrivals straight to Bali in 2025

gridlock.label: daily gridlock on Jl. Raya Ubud, 10:00 to 21:00

bangli.label: official attractions in Bangli, more than Badung's 39

numbers.source: Sources: BPS Bali, Bali Tourism Office, DJPK.
numbers.chart: Bars of very different heights: a few places carry most of the crowd

trust.title: Numbers by code. Words by AI.
trust.intro: A travel assistant is only useful if you can trust what it says. So MARGI separates the two jobs.

forecast.title: The forecast is a model, not a guess
forecast.body: Crowd curves, holidays, ceremonies and live traffic go into one transparent calculation. Every plan shows how it was decided.

roads.title: The roads are real
roads.body: Travel time and delays come from live routing. If the provider is down, MARGI says so instead of inventing a number.

ai.title: AI explains, it never invents
ai.body: The language model writes the answer. A check rejects any figure that did not come from the data.

diagrams.forecast: A day of crowd as bars, with a calm window in the afternoon
diagrams.roads: A route between two stops with a congested stretch marked

cta.title: Go where it's calm.
cta.body: Calmer for you, fairer for the places and families you pass on the way.
cta.art: Rice terraces and a winding path under palm trees
